turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good afternoon, am I speaking with Mrs. Iyer from Kolkata?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, this is she. Who is calling please?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hello Maam, my name is Rohan from Zenith Finance. I am calling to offer you a premium credit card with a limit of one lakh rupees.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: One lakh? Why do you need to tell me this now, I do not use such cards.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: It is just a special offer for senior citizens with zero annual fees for the first year. It helps with medical expenses and travel.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: I have my pension and that is enough for me. I don't like these new things.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I completely understand your hesitation, Mrs. Iyer. Would you prefer if I sent the brochure and details to your email instead?

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Email? My son handles that for me. Can you send it to him?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Of course, if you can provide the email address, I will send all the documents for you to review at your own pace.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Let me check the diary first. Give me a minute, I am not sure if I remember it correctly.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No problem at all, please take your time. I can also call you back tomorrow morning if that is easier.

turns.speaker: receiver
turns.text: Yes, call tomorrow morning. I will ask my son and then we will see.
